mino.mp4.title: day 1 of road to $1m/month After hitting back-to-back $400K months, I...
mino.mp4.description: day 1 of road to $1m/month After hitting back-to-back $400K months, I almost cried at dinner in front of my whole team.  For the past 2 years of building this business, I've lost motivation so many months to actually grow.  Is it greedy to want bigger numbers? is it ego? Am I just watching too much Jeremy Haynes? This past week we had our first ever team retreat, with 9 of our team members, all in person, making memories.  We're gunning for back to back $400K months this month.  things had never been better, yet ironically I’ve been feeling so anxious this whole trip.  So when i was forced to give a surprise toast to my whole team of 9 at a steakhouse, my voice literally started to shake from the fear  In that moment, I realized why i had so much anxiety.  I lowkey thought it’s cuz we weren’t making enough money not gonna lie.  But deep down, I was scared of losing something so special that we had built. When i was in college, i felt like i left friends behind to drop out, and isolate myself to pursue my social media dreams.  ever since then, i think friendship always felt temporary, and frankly too easy to leave.  I think i was scared of letting that happen this time too.  But this time, it was with a group of friends who i have the gift of working with every day, on the same mission, the same business, sharing the same fruits of our labor.  There is nothing more i could’ve asked for in life, and when you’re there, you start to just fear how long it can truly last like this.  A lot of business gurus talk about culture like it's some genius 200 IQ chess play.  Maybe I'm just dumb, cuz I never planned for our team to feel like we got along this well.  So why $1M/month? Obviously the number's sick, I'm not gonna lie — it sounds cool, come on now.  But I truly believe $1M/month represents the umbrella of everyone's dreams, being able to keep creating memories and growth for this group of 20-something year old Content Academy Avengers.  And yes I will put every follicle into it.

mino.mp4.description: yesterday my business hit its first 400k month, and i wanted to reflect on this idea of goal setting    i feel like it’s been this odd push and pull of my inner hormozi saying:  “Do more. Outwork your doubt. Become the man you’d be proud of.”   and my kid saying that a goal will just disappoint me again, when i hit it.   but i look back and i have no regrets, not because bwahahaha i became a business beast!!1!    but becuz some of the best memories i had came from those 13 months of chasing   and i know most ppl say “uaghh you only chase more becuz u feel insecure!!”   but i started to miss the feeling of having a pursuit that got me up at 9am feeling equally anxious and excited    and i now know my next goal of $800k/month won’t make me feel any different   but i think i’m truly in my happy place when i have that dream that i can truly put my all into
